page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at the top, page number at the top right. Small, faint marginal notes in the right margin, beside the lines "iam", "Iphi-", "quas", "red-", "obscu-", "Pyr-", "Agathoclé", "Pyr-" and "deinde". Stripes in the left margin are show-through and are not transcribed.

main_text.p: plo commoti, qui ægrè ferebant, in potestate populi civitatem esse, clàm missis Lacedæmonem hominibus suis sollicitando & promittendo effectum dederunt, ut Lacedæmonii spe occupandæ urbis ad parandum vicini maris imperium oportunissimæ classem cum exercitu istuc mitterent à sociis adjuti, urbemque Corcyram terra marique obsiderent. Sed obsidionem fortiter sustinuere obsessi, & fiducia auxilii Attici adventantis animosiores facti, observata obsidentium negligentia erumpentes in confusionem primum eos dederunt, mox fortunam sequentes, casso eorum duce, qui ad serendam laborantibus opem accurrerat, castris eosdem exuerunt:& advecto iam[illegible, ~3 letters] cum classe & copiis Attico duce Iphi[illegible, ~3 letters]crate, freti ope ejus tota infula exegeruunt, navefque Peloponnesias, in quas[illegible, ~3 letters] trepidi se conjecerant, fuga sibi confulere coëgerunt. Sic quies Corcyræis reparata, & totum mare Ionium Iphicratis opera tutum tranquillumque red[illegible, ~3 letters]ditum. Sequentia Corcyræorum obscu[illegible, ~3 letters]ra. Hoc solum ex Plutarcho in vita Pyr[illegible, ~3 letters]rhi cognoscimus, urbem ab Agathoclé[illegible, ~3 letters] Syracusis dominante occupatam fuisse, & in dotem Lanasiæ filiæ ipsius Pyr[illegible, ~3 letters]rho Epiri regi nubenti cessisse: deinde[illegible, ~3 letters] cum

page.notes: Right-margin notes are very small and faint; their letters cannot be read, so each is marked illegible at its place. The bottom-right faint mark is doubtful and is given as a possible catchword. Long s is written as s; the ct ligature in "faƈti" is written as "facti". The last line "cum" is indented and may begin a new line of the sentence rather than a new paragraph; it is kept with the paragraph.
